name: Brazier
overview: The biblical term 'brazier' encompasses both a skilled craftsman working with brass and copper, as seen in Genesis 4:22 where Tubalcain is described as an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron, and a practical utensil used for warming, illustrated by the fire burning on the hearth in Jeremiah 36:22-23. These verses highlight the dual significance of braziers in Scripture—both as a symbol of human craftsmanship and as a source of physical warmth, reflecting the providential care God extends through everyday means.
